settings.heading: Shipping and delivery
settings.intro: Orders ship from Dubai. UAE delivery is free. International orders are prepaid and sent with Aramex tracking.
settings.dubai_detail: Order by 6 PM. Orders placed after 6 PM will be delivered next-day. Dubai only.
settings.uae_detail: Order by 6 PM for next-day delivery. Orders placed after 6 PM will be processed the following day. Covers Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah.
settings.intl_intro: All supported international shipments are sent through Aramex. International orders must be prepaid. Transit estimates begin after dispatch and can be affected by customs clearance, local import restrictions, public holidays or remote-area delivery.
settings.gcc_region: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar and Oman
settings.std_region: All international destinations except the UAE, GCC countries, Canada and North Macedonia
settings.intl_note: Delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees. Rates are flat by destination.
settings.customs_body:
Customs duties, taxes and import charges are not included unless they are shown at checkout. The recipient is responsible for paying applicable destination-country charges.

Please provide a complete address, a reachable telephone number and accurate delivery information.

Delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees. Contact us and we’ll assist with carrier-related delivery issues.

Return or redelivery costs caused by refusal, unpaid duties, an incorrect address or an unresponsive recipient may be deducted from the refund.

Certain products may be restricted by local destination-country regulations. Customers are responsible for confirming local import eligibility.
